decision: Qualify registered historical account compatibility at e26305a: all 36 controls, 6360 trade records, 2499924 full path rows and original daily/report publications reproduce exactly. Every incremental balance reconciles within 1e-8 USD; independent Decimal cashflow audit, 270 archived tests and full source-archive replay pass. Full prospective source/provider/clock/trigger replay remains unqualified. Preserve frozen economics, both seals and live deployment.
falsifier: A changed source identity, independent arithmetic discrepancy, incorrect quantity/fee/funding attribution, unregistered clock/cost interpretation or failed source/provider/legacy-control parity invalidates the affected replay claim. No prospective economic result is available before its fixed seal and no promotion follows from component tests.
hypothesis: A fixed original-versus-equal allocation comparison on a newly registered calendar can measure whether increased return warrants changed exposure/drawdown without fitting new weights.
limitations: Performance confidence remains low. These are reused historical source/cost/clock variants, not independent new-study trades or evidence of improved returns.
The legacy presentation preserves verified supplied net serialization and original float operation order; the separately recomputed ledger is reconciled within the predeclared 1e-8 USD tolerance.
Reproduction uses the pinned source and recorded Python/dependency environment. Other numerical environments are not qualified.
Generic account and historical adapter tests do not qualify source-as-of assembly, provider/regime parity, modeled fill/trigger timing or full prospective funding/metadata/terminal coverage.
The registered adapter rejects sealed contracts; the full future evaluator remains unconnected and no system-wide access-barrier claim is made.
Both study outcomes remain sealed. The fixed new window cannot be extended to hide missing observations and overlaps the existing sealed experiment.
Historical allocation increased drawdown and exposure; later full-fee results worsened. Compatibility qualification does not change those economic findings.
Collector health is a timestamped observation. Metadata publication lag, other IP clients and other disk writers remain unmeasured.
No live strategy, allocation, TUI, configuration, signing client, order or trading process changed. This is not a running paper evaluation.
